_purpose: port-authorization labelling PoC: one SO per verdict class

Ingress.regA.reason: attacker enters on a guest port => unauthorized

Ingress.regB.reason: cell indexed by an unspoofable principal => negative control

Ingress.regC.reason: Writable by every declared role, stated as an EXPLICIT grant. Previously this relied on shared:true alone to authorize, but sharing state among participants describes reading it - P4xos's learner state is read by all participants and written only by acceptors - so `shared` no longer widens write authorization. Only a positive writable_by grant does. Ports 5+ are outside every role, so an attacker there still scores unauthorized.
